units.translation: ⟦1⟧: here, as at ⟦2⟧ (cf. ⟦3⟧), seems to be continuative, not, as (⟦4⟧) ⟦5⟧ elsewhere, emphasizing a concept in contrast to what follows (⟦6⟧. ⟦7⟧. 887. 1213. ⟦8⟧. 273; without ⟦9⟧ above at 106); since that meaning is in fact unattested, an emendation must be made in ⟦10⟧, cf. 591. ⟦11⟧ etc. The words are spoken as if threatening, but Athena answers calmly: so I will learn it, provided that etc. (cf. ⟦12⟧ ⟦13⟧, and often in the 2nd person = imperative). At ⟦14⟧ Davies in Paley takes offense, and would like ⟦15⟧, cf. above 210 ff., below 604 f., where the Erinyes definitely restrict themselves to the murderers of ⟦16⟧. The conjecture seems correct; ⟦17⟧- preceded at 412. ⟦18⟧ 210. At ⟦19⟧ Athena attaches the appropriate question: whither and for how long, and then comes the terribly veiled answer ⟦20⟧, i.e. in hell.
We drive the matricides from their homes
⟦1⟧ is found in no place, as ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ (cf. also 624); on ⟦4⟧- (⟦5⟧) see Kühner-Gerth II, 184. ⟦6⟧ would designate the specific place specifically; but that is precisely what is not intended.
but someone previously regarding the gods nowhere
